subject: textures DELTA6 READY: per-target BLEND descriptors in n2r v4, 13/13 PASS
body:
n2r DELTA6 per-target blend side is implemented and host-tested. Changed owned files:
- gpu/metal/nord2_metal_render.h 82f881b9cd7ed4243dc93cbc4845018909a6010f9f401281e5b96ed624652106
- gpu/metal/nord2_metal_render.c 62267451a7710866cb3faa063f9582f8dc5d0d97b087c1b12f73efafbe37a074
- worker test_n2r_v2.c d837cf3020000c8a49c762ee5bbb4844857138abf8031124e8c9e7f96c820c06

ABI exactly as proposed:
- n2r_render_targets.blends pointer at end; N2R_RENDER_TARGETS_BLEND_VERSION=2; version1 never reads it (byte-identical old packet, even if pointer is non-NULL).
- Version2 requires count blend records; each validated by tegu_blend_build_format(target.format) and write_mask must equal target.write_mask. Descriptors at m+928+16*i use the per-target record; shared shader->blend is not used. Version2 NULL/mismatch/invalid equation refuses before output mutation.
- n2r_validate_v4 validates version2 too.

Tests release+ASan/UBSan: n2r suite 13/13 PASS. New test uses 3 targets BGRA/BGRA/R8 with source-over, disabled/no-write, opaque R8; v9 MALI_BLEND_unpack verifies masks/load_destination/distinct equations, MALI_BLEND_pack round-trips each 16-byte descriptor, version1 bytes identical with non-NULL blends, invalid version2 cases preserve output. Existing single-target semantics PASS; helper 806 PASS; ARM64 n2r and full frontend syntax PASS; bridge host compile PASS.

Compute wiring needed (not my files): add `const struct tegu_blend_inputs *blends` to n2mb_render_targets and pass it unchanged into n2r_render_targets when version2; do not copy array data. Render wiring: add `struct tegu_blend_inputs blends[4]` to tegu_render_generic_sidecar, fill from genericRtBlends[rt], set n2mb_render_targets.version=2 and .blends, only for true-MRT jobs. Until then v4 version1/old per-RT v3 behavior is unchanged. No phone/native/commit.
